answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network anchors identity to a verifiable cipher puzzle whose solution requires irreversible stake burning. Staking costs scale superlinearly as $C(n) \propto n^{1.5}$, creating an unassailable financial ridge that exhausts adversarial resources. Even if an attacker controls vast hardware, this economic basalt foundation makes spawning forged agents exponentially cost-prohibitive compared to honest coordination.
